physicalNotes: Radius 2.03 Jupiter radii from Nielsen et al. 2020 (2020A&A...639A..76N), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...639A..76N/abstract): 145,128.8 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 3.213 Jupiter masses (Nielsen et al. 2020, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2020A&A...639A..76N), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...639A..76N/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
